about_the_game:
🎶 Etude is a competitive multiplayer music improvisation game where players use MIDI instruments to perform together in real time. Think music as an e-sport.

Up to 6 players join a shared session where every note played contributes the Band Consensus. Each played or released note is a vote that shapes the consensus of allowed roots and scales - a breathing musical space of optionality. Stay within the consensus and others hear your notes; break it, and your notes won’t be heard.

🧠 Core Gameplay

  • 🎹 Play with MIDI controllers in real time

  • 🌀 Band Consensus is a living breathing harmonic space that evolves as you play

  • ❌ Errors are visual only - your wrong notes won’t disrupt others' sound

  • 📈 Symphonic Score: Like Elo, but for musical accuracy, timing, and leadership

  • ⚖️ Control Ratio & Consensus Leadership prevent coasting or hogging notes 💤 / 📢

🕹️ Free Mode

  • Play without restrictions with your friends. Free Mode removes timers, scoring, and penalties - leaving only the shared harmonic space, ideal for relaxed jamming, practicing, testing ideas, or introducing new players at your own pace.

🎯 Practice Mode

  • 🎼 Click the grid to pick a Scale+Key (or a Harmony Type) → the graph auto-fills with all matching chords/arpeggios/scales.

  • 🔗 Draw a path between nodes to build a drill; 🎛️ (set pattern, one/both hands, start octave & span per step) then 💾 save practice.

  • ▶️ Play the chain on your MIDI controller—fast setup, easy customization.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or Apple GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple GPU or dedicated GPU (e.g., Radeon Pro)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Apple Silicon. Best performance on M2 or newer.
